{{Top|leg}}
A '''taxicart''' was a type of [[cart]] equipped with a harness. Taxicarts were used for transport in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pelek Baw/Legends|Pelek Baw]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]]. At least one such cart was drawn by a [[Yuzzem]].<ref name="MrGlass">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>
